Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't perform the processing specified for "by" in such an effect, the rest of the effect won't activate.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your hand is trashed from, you may play 1 level 4 or lower [Demon] or [Titan] trait card from your trash without paying the cost.
